audit_items.proof_trace: Storage Get() returns VerifiedRODataColumn assuming full verification occurred at save time. However, data columns saved via reconstruction path (processDataColumnSidecarsFromExecution→receiveDataColumnSidecar→ReceiveDataColumn→Save) bypass gossip validation. Reconstructed columns are marked as Verified without RequireValidProposerSignature, RequireSidecarParentValid, or state transition checks, violating the invariant.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker runs malicious proposer or compromises execution layer reconstruction. Creates invalid data columns that pass only basic KZG/inclusion proofs but violate state transitions or have invalid proposer signatures. Saves them locally via reconstruction path. When peers request these columns by-root, handler serves unvalidated data marked as Verified, propagating invalid columns network-wide.
